messages:
Alex M.: KPMG reached out — they want a chain-of-custody for audit log exports plus a mapping of alerting rules to SOC2/ISO controls. Specifically: access ledger for the logs, export SHA256s, KMS key alias + rotation evidence, and any RBAC changes affecting log access. Can we pull a package by EOD? @Priya S. @Sam R.
compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence packages should include (1) raw logs or samples, (2) signed manifest with hashes, (3) IAM/RBAC diffs, (4) KMS rotation events, (5) export transfer logs. See Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/procedures/audit-evidence.
Priya S.: Do they need full raw logs or is sampling OK? Also confirm whether they accept CSV summaries for alert mappings. Sampling would speed things up.
Sam R.: I can export a timeboxed set of logs and produce hashes. Example export workflow:
```bash
# pull logs for 2025-03-10 to 2025-03-14
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-logs/audit/2025/03/10/ local_audit/ --recursive 
find local_audit/ -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; > manifest.sha256
# bundle and gzip
tar -czf evidence_chain_20250315.tar.gz local_audit/ manifest.sha256
```
Elasticsearch query (example) to pull alerting events:
```json
{ "query": { "bool": { "filter": [ { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2025-03-10T00:00:00Z", "lte": "2025-03-14T23:59:59Z" } } }, { "term": { "event.type": "alert" } } ] } } }
```
Jordan L.: FYI the RBAC change that matters is PR #7892 (adds audit-readonly role, scoped to prod-audit bucket). Deployed 2025-03-10. PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/7892. I can attach the git diff and deploy job logs.
Casey B.: KMS details: alias/redwood-audit (key id: 1234abcd-5678-ef00-1122). Key is HSM-backed, automatic monthly rotation configured; last rotation event: 2025-02-28. We can pull CloudTrail events for GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/RotateKey. Sample CloudTrail filter:
```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE requestParameters.keyId = '1234abcd-5678-ef00-1122' AND eventTime BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-03-15'
```
Taylor N.: For chain-of-custody, include who initiated the export (ticket owner), the host/instance used, script SHA, and signed manifest. Let's use ticket INC-4321 for traceability and have the exporter GPG-sign the manifest. Also we should add an access snapshot showing who had S3 read permissions at that time.
Priya S.: OK. I'll create a control mapping doc that ties each artifact to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO 27001 A.12.4 entries and a short narrative for auditors. Artifacts to include:
- manifest.sha256 (GPG-signed)
- evidence_chain_20250315.tar.gz (logs + alert exports)
- RBAC_diff_PR7892.diff + deploy logs
- KMS rotation events (CloudTrail snippets)
- IAM policy snapshot (policy versions)
- export_ticket_INC-4321 and approver audit trail
Alex M.: Assignments: Sam -> export + manifest + upload; Casey -> KMS rotation evidence + CloudTrail snippets; Jordan -> RBAC diff + deploy logs; Priya -> control mapping doc + narrative; Taylor -> sign manifest and produce access snapshot. Deadline EOD today (2025-03-15). I'll assemble into a single tar and upload to secure share. @compliance-bot please mark this thread as audit-evidence in tracker. :thumbsup:
Sam R.: Uploading to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/KPMG/1976543210/ now. Will create a signed manifest and DM the signed artifact link. GPG command used: `gpg --armor --detach-sign manifest.sha256`.
Casey B.: Exported CloudTrail events and KMS rotation log to same bucket under kms/rotation/2025-02-28.json. Added event IDs for cross-reference.
Jordan L.: Pushed RBAC diff and deploy job logs to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/KPMG/1976543210/rbac/. PR#7892 archived.
Priya S.: Control mapping draft at https://confluence.redwood/security/audit-mapping/KPMG-1976543210. I'll paste the short narrative into the evidence bundle as control-mapping.txt.
Taylor N.: Signed manifest uploaded as manifest.sha256.asc. Access snapshot (IAM policy dump) is in iam/policy-snapshot-20250315.json.
Alex M.: Great work everyone — I'll package the bundle and perform a final verification of SHA256s. Will post transfer SHA and chain-of-custody manifest when complete. If auditors follow up with specific evidence IDs, respond in this thread so we can track.
compliance-bot: Evidence package created: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/KPMG/1976543210/evidence_chain_20250315.tar.gz (hashed: 3b7f2a9e...). Link permission: restricted. Ticket INC-4321 updated.
